top_choice_rationale: P002 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) is the most mature and best-attributed result on the slate. Magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms is a distinct principle from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion control prizes. The 10^-18 result is backed by identified systematics and direct clock-to-clock comparisons across several continents, and the two-name allocation matches the committee's near-unanimous naming. The residual objections are that it is closer to a measurement capability than a new phenomenon and that it draws a credit line through a contested field. P001 (moire graphene) is the stronger discovery of new matter but is under a decade old, has an unsettled pairing mechanism, and leaves Yuan Cao outside the three-name limit with the priority record unverified, so it ranks second. Awarding nothing is ranked last because two credible, independently reproduced candidates are available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; for disclosure, membership in PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and XL-Calibur has no link to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer
